FULL TEXT:
PANJAB UNIVERSITY CONSTITUTENT COLLEGE
Village Patto Hira Singh, Nihal Singh Wala
Moga
Ref. No. 452/D/PUCCNSW Date: 15/02/2024
Walk -In-Interview for the Post of Guest Faculty in Physical Education
Walk-in Interview for the post of Guest Faculty in the subject of Physical Education at
Panjab University Constituent College, Village Patto Hira Singh, Nihal Singh Wala,
(Moga) for the session 2023-2024 will be held as detailed below:
No. of Posts : Physical Education-01
Qualification : As per Panjab University, Chandigarh/UGC norms.
Date of Interview : 26/02/2024 (Monday)
Venue : Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
Time : 10.00 AM
Salary : As Per Panjab University norms..
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at the time
of interview. The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at
website (http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php pages 1 to 9).
Candidates are required to bring one set of photocopy of their certificates. Interested
candidates can send their duly filled form on email: pucc.nsw@gmail.com and appear
for interview as detailed above. No separate invitation will be sent to the candidates
for the interview.
Principal
